油（少量）: Oil (small amount; excluding kerosene, gasoline and motor oil)
植木の枝葉: Garden tree branches and leaves (under 3 cm thick and under 30 cm long)
ガステーブル・コンロ: Gas stove / gas cooktop (kitchen and tabletop types; gas canister removed)
釜（ガス）: Kama (gas-fired; e.g. gas rice cooker or gas bath boiler)
剪定枝（直径３㎝・長さ３０㎝）: Pruned branches (up to 3 cm in diameter and up to 30 cm long)
タバコの空箱: Empty cigarette pack (paper box only; excluding plastic wrap and foil)
ティッシュペーパーの空箱: Empty tissue box (excluding plastic film at the opening)
バット（金属製・プラスチック製）: Bat (baseball etc.; metal, plastic; excluding children's plastic bats)
木片（太さ３㎝以上）: Wood pieces (3 cm or more but up to 10 cm thick, up to 2 m long)
